verdict.rationale: Snyk documents a built-in 'Remediation Agent' that is explicitly LLM-driven: it scans a project, generates a fix plan enriched with Snyk security intelligence, applies fixes, and verifies results, runnable via 'snyk fix --agentic', '/snyk-fix'/'/snyk-batch-fix' slash commands in a coding assistant, or the CLI. This is reinforced by DeepCode AI autofix and Snyk Studio/MCP integration for agentic dev environments. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Remediation Agent's real-world reliability (community evidence only covers general Snyk PR/dependency complaints, not this specific AI assistant feature), and more detail on scope/limits of autonomous fix application
